name: Targorr the Dread drops loot (#7743)
contract: #7743: a player reports that Targorr the Dread, the Stockade boss, gives no loot. His creature entry 1696
carries eleven creature_loot_template rows, including item 3630 at 100 % and three reference groups, so the
table is not empty and a kill has to drop something; the CoA difficulty variants 101696 and 201696 carry the
same 100 % row plus a 1 % row. This scenario spawns the base entry, kills it and opens its loot, which either
reproduces the report or shows the drop working and moves the suspicion to the difficulty variant.
